name: winvm-bridge
description: WinVM Bridge - 分层解耦、标准协议驱动、强监管的插件体系，使宿主机 AI Agent 完全操作 Windows 虚拟机

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const cp=require('child_process');const dir=process.argv[1];const exts=['.test.js','.test.mjs'];const files=fs.readdirSync(dir).sort().filter(function(f){return exts.some(function(e){return f.endsWith(e)})});let bad=0;for(const f of files){const r=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--test',dir+'/'+f],{stdio:'inherit'});if(r.status===0){continue}bad+=1;console.error('[per-file] FAILED '+f+' status '+r.status)}console.error('[per-file] files='+files.length+' failed='+bad);process.exit(bad===0?0:1)" tests/unit
